(i) the APreClus approach can be applied to large datasets, (ii) the APreClsu approach can be applied on large datasets, (iii) APreClus outperforms a recently proposed scaffold based graph clustering algorithm, (iv) the APreCus approach is applicable in the virtual screening context, (v) our approach is the first step towards structing chemical space.
our algorithm is capable of clustering millions of chemical structures in a reasonable time.

(1) APreClus, a novel online instance incremental clustering algorithm, is able to cluster very large chemical datasets in reasonable time, (2) the scaffold-based clustering approach is able to partition the clusters produced by APreClus into a finer granularity and (3) the resulting clustering of millions of molecules is able to capture large structural similarities.

the development of efficient algorithms for the analysis of very large chemical databases.
the development of efficient and scalable algorithms to structure chemical space, which is an important prerequisite for the development of novel and more efficient cheminformatics methods and tools.
the development and application of graph mining methods to the analysis of chemical structures and their properties.
